The Sporting News brings you a look at how the USMNT roster for the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal might look once it has been officially unveiled. ## USMNT roster for November 2026 matches vs. Pochettino is expected to call around 26 players for the pair of CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal matches against Haiti in November.
